jobs.title: Ecological Restoration Technician (Seasonal)
jobs.summary: Native planting, invasive species removal and site prep across TRCA restoration sites. Crew meets at the Vaughan yard; transport to sites provided. Chainsaw and OBBN certification an asset.

jobs.title: GIS Technician, Watershed Data
jobs.summary: Maintain spatial datasets, produce maps and field-collection apps (Field Maps / ArcGIS) for watershed monitoring programs. Diploma or degree in GIS, geography or environmental science.

jobs.title: Field Assistant, Stream Monitoring
jobs.summary: Assist a graduate research project on urban stream geomorphology: bank pin surveys, cross-section resurveys, water quality sampling. Fieldwork accessible by TTC. 6-month contract.

jobs.title: Educational Assistant (French-language)
jobs.summary: Support students in a French-language elementary classroom. Bilingual (FR/EN) required. Experience with diverse learners an asset.

jobs.title: Restoration Crew Lead
jobs.summary: Lead a small planting and maintenance crew. Valid Ontario G licence and use of a personal vehicle required to travel between sites.

jobs.title: Environmental Technician
jobs.summary: Phase I/II ESA support, soil and groundwater sampling, monitoring. Full G licence and reliable vehicle required for site visits.

jobs.title: Nature Interpreter (Fall Contract)
jobs.org: City of Toronto - Parks, Forestry & Recreation
jobs.summary: Deliver school and public nature programs at a TTC-accessible environmental centre. Background in biology, environmental science or education.

jobs.title: Water Quality Field Technician (OBBN)
jobs.summary: Benthic sampling and water quality assessment under OBBN protocols. Crew transport provided from Downsview. OBBN certification an asset.

jobs.title: Watershed Resources Technician
jobs.summary: Permanent role in stream monitoring and data management for the Grand River watershed. Example of a permanent position outside the GTA.
